verdict.summary_en: Chinese/English delivery note SN-260818-893 dated 2026-08-18 from Dongguan Precision Housings to Soony DC Hamburg. It lists one line, PRM-GH6-PIN, Pre-order Pin "GH6" (enamel), 24.000 PCS in 12 packages, gross weight 228 kg, carrier Nordhav Shipping A/S. A blue stamp reads RECEIVED 21.09.2026 DC-HAM. The purchase order field is blank ("—"). The consignee signature line and the remarks are empty. There are no handwritten corrections.
red_flags: Purchase order field (采购订单) shows only a dash, so the note carries no PO reference.
Consignee signature line (收货签字) is blank, although the note carries a RECEIVED stamp.
No received quantity is recorded, only the stamp date, so there is no check of received against delivered quantity.
The quantity 24.000 PCS is read as 24,000 pieces, which fits 12 packages and 228 kg. The notation is ambiguous, so confirm it.
observations: The red company seal overlaps the table's unit column header and the packages cell. The packages value '12' is partly covered but still reads as 12, and it matches 件数: 12 below the table.
The seal text is partly covered, but the legible part reads as Dongguan Precision Housings Co. Ltd. with 出货专用章.
The blue RECEIVED stamp is slightly tilted and clearly legible.
The remarks field (备注) is empty.
There is a barcode at the top right.
There is no handwriting on the document.
